package.name: mapping_localization_pkg
package.description: Mapping and localization approaches for the Helios A4WD3 mecanum rover, beyond the 2D slam_toolbox pipeline in sensor_fusion. Currently: RTAB-Map (RGB-D + LiDAR registration, GTSAM pose-graph optimization) for 3D mapping and localization, fed by the ZED 2i, Hokuyo UST-10LX, and the existing EKF-fused odometry.
